pages.title: RF Accelerating Cavity
pages.text: A resonant cavity driven by a tachyon klystron that gives each passing particle a precisely timed kick. Inside, radio waves bounce in a standing pattern. It hums at a frequency I can feel in my teeth.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Particles in a ring need repeated kicks to gain energy. I built an RF resonator cell into spacetime casing and drove it with a tachyon klystron, so every kick arrived on time.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Antiproton Decelerator, Hyperion Synchrotron, Nuclide Forge.
